title: Transform each value
summary: Elixir: Transform each value. Multiply by 3.
introduction: Enum.map builds a list using the result of a function for each item.

blocks.text: Install Elixir. Save each example as lesson.exs and run elixir lesson.exs.

blocks.title: Transform each value
blocks.code:
values = Enum.map([2, 3], fn n -> n * 2 end)
IO.puts(Enum.join(values, ", "))

blocks.text: Enum.map collects each doubled result, then Enum.join formats them.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Keep the returned list if you need it later.
